notes.title: Sushi Skin Pack
notes.notes:
Roll around with the new Sushi skin pack!

This pack features:
- Salmon Nigiri
- Shrimp Nigiri
- Futomaki
- Nikuman

notes.title: WIP IMPROVEMENTS
notes.notes:
Hi community!

We are getting close to the release date and I'm making last adjustments that I would like to share with you:

- Implementing STEAM Achievement
- Adding Graphics settings customization
- Improve movement system
- Fix minor bugs


If there is something else you think I can add before the release, please let me know it!

Thanks!

notes.title: WIP UPDATES
notes.notes:
Hi everyone,

First of all thank, you for your support and for the feedback received from the demo during steam next fest.

I'm working on a patch for the demo with some updates to see if it meets player expectations.

CONTROLLER:
- I will add D-pad control support
- Swap confirm/cancel buttons
- Remove 45º orientation option for controller (No will work with up down right left)

KEYBOARD:
- New key to pop up pause/settings menu
- Improve mouse camera rotation system

If I'm missing something feel free to comment and I will work to improve it

Thanks
